LanguageData.LP_ScrollTeleport.label: scroll of teleportation
LanguageData.LP_ScrollTeleport.description: A scroll covered in spatial runes. After reading it you instantly return to the player's main base, landing beside your bed (or near the colony center without a bed). Reading it while already at the main base has no effect and doesn't use up the scroll.
LanguageData.LP_ScrollRevivify.label: scroll of revivify
LanguageData.LP_ScrollRevivify.description: An extremely rare gold-sealed scroll. Use on a humanlike corpse dead no more than 1 day to revive it; afterwards it has "resurrection sickness" for 3 days (consciousness -30%). No effect on liches, necromantic constructs and corpses whose brains were devoured.
LanguageData.LP_ScrollProtectionEvil.label: scroll of protection from evil
LanguageData.LP_ScrollProtectionEvil.description: Reading it spreads a 5×5 golden ward under your feet for 1 day. Hostile necromantic constructs, mind flayers, and dominated or enslaved people can't walk into the ward.
LanguageData.LP_ScrollFireball.label: scroll of fireball
LanguageData.LP_ScrollFireball.description: A scroll sealing a fireball. Reading it sets off a fire explosion of radius 3 at a target point within 30 cells.
LanguageData.LP_ScrollTrueSeeing.label: scroll of true seeing
LanguageData.LP_ScrollTrueSeeing.description: After reading, reveals all invisible people on the current map for 1 hour (including invisibility potions, great wyrms, psionic concealment and psychic invisibility), and instantly removes the "dominated" state imposed by mind flayers from everyone on the map (including colony thralls).
LanguageData.LP_ScrollFleshToStone.label: scroll of flesh to stone
LanguageData.LP_ScrollFleshToStone.description: Use on one enemy within 30 cells (body size up to 2): it slows down, and after 30 seconds turns into a statue item with the person sealed whole inside, restored automatically after a day.
LanguageData.LP_ScrollFearGaze.label: scroll of fear gaze
LanguageData.LP_ScrollFearGaze.description: A spell scroll copied by a lich. Even a non-lich reading it can cast the level 3 lich spell "Fear gaze": hostile humanlikes within 4.9 cells of the target point panic and flee, and hostile animals are stunned for 5 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_ScrollNecroticBlast.label: scroll of necrotic blast
LanguageData.LP_ScrollNecroticBlast.description: A spell scroll copied by a lich. Even a non-lich reading it can cast the level 6 lich spell "Necrotic blast": every hostile target within 3.9 cells of the target point takes 15 necrotic damage, ignoring armor.
LanguageData.LP_PetrifiedStatue.label: statue
LanguageData.LP_PetrifiedStatue.description: A person turned to stone by a petrification scroll, sealed whole inside the statue; returns to flesh by itself after a day. If the statue is destroyed, the person inside is gone too.
